excerpt: Legal and Compliance Challenges in Gig Worker Recruitment: What Employers Need to Know Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Artificial Intelligence has transformed the hiring process, making it faster, more data-driven, and scalable. From automated resume screening to AI-driven candidate matching, technology now plays a critical role in recruitment. Yet, as more companies adopt AI tools, many discover that poor implementation can create new challenges rather than solving old ones. When AI is not used strategically, it can unintentionally screen out top talent, introduce bias, or damage the candidate
